source: BBOC 2025 Conference USA Betting Preview (Mike Calabrese/Josh 'Duck' Nunn)

teams.key_avoids: THE WEAKEST SCHEDULE IN FBS (136th of 136) — favored in 11-12 games. Toughest game is JMU at home (Sept 20); draws Bowling Green + Jacksonville State early (before JSU's new staff gels); AVOIDS Western Kentucky; hosts Kennesaw State in the finale (revenge for 2024's shocking loss).
teams.bboc_notes: The clear favorite (+140 to win CUSA — Mike passes the price but likes 7-1 on a PERFECT 12-0 regular season). Elite G5 continuity (same HC Jamie Chadwell/OC/DC), 15th in returning production (13th on D). Ethan Vasco is the ideal fit — a willing dual-threat runner Chadwell recruited at Coastal, unlike Kaden Salter who wouldn't stick his nose in the run game. Secondary could be special (all juniors/seniors) but the D must get back to 2023 havoc (10th, 21 INT) from 2024's 78th/97th; lost edge TJ Bush. OL breaks in 3 starters around C Aaron Fanimo. Only real early hedge is the wk2 (actually wk toughest) JMU home game before the 7-1 flyer is dead on Sept 20.

teams.key_avoids: Fade spots at Toledo and at LSU; also road at Missouri State (Ryan Beard family ties) and at Louisiana Tech, plus a short-week trip to Delaware.
teams.bboc_notes: The Bailey-Zappe blueprint again — 5th straight new OC (Rick Bowie) arrives from Abilene Christian WITH his QB Maverick McIvor (a Zappe/Zappy-style air-raid gunslinger who was 5-drives-5-TDs in the spring and could throw for 4,000+). But 125th in returning production (only 3 starters back) and the defense gave up 3,097 rushing yards last year (the '3,000 club') and lost its top-12 tacklers — so it plays FAST and gives up a ton, screaming OVER every week (Duck + Mike already bet the wk0 over vs Sam Houston). Both lean over 7.5 but see limited edge (a couple non-con losses baked in). One of ~5 teams jockeying for the #2 spot behind Liberty; electrifying but the D is the Achilles heel.

teams.key_avoids: Only surefire loss is at Texas. Winnable: UT Martin, Missouri State, Delaware, New Mexico State, Jacksonville State, ULM, La Tech at home; gets Liberty at home; road at Sam Houston + Kennesaw. Duck counts ~10 winnable games.
teams.bboc_notes: Mike's mispriced DARK HORSE — over 5.5 and a title sprinkle at 13-1 (he'd price them 8-9/1). Year 2 of Scotty Walden (high-energy motivator); 43rd in returning production (10th offense); back-to-back best-ever recruiting classes now bubbling up, and the 3-star portal replacements upgrade the talent from the 2023 shakeup. MLB Mikey Davie (McNeese, 311 tackles/3yr) anchors the D; loaded skill room (Kehshaun Wilson RB, Kenny Odom WR). The one wet blanket: the OL returns just one starter (99th in line yards, 101st pass-block). QB battle (Locklear vs Malachi Nelson, who is NOT leading it per camp reports). Front-of-the-line for the #2 CUSA spot.

teams.key_avoids: CANNOT win CUSA (FBS newcomer — no title eligibility). Surefire losses at Colorado + at Liberty; favored at home vs Delaware State, Middle Tennessee, La Tech, UTEP. A 25-day stretch with one game + two byes in the middle.
teams.bboc_notes: [Eligibility note: newcomer, ineligible for the CUSA title game.] The most FBS-ready FCS mover — 20th nationally in returning production (4th on defense), a proud, hard-nosed program (Ryan Carty, Keeler protégé, 26-11). Defense (strong 3-safety 3-3-5 secondary + edge Noah Matthews from Kentucky) should keep them in games and limit explosives from day one — potentially a top-4 CUSA defense. Offense has moving parts: lost RB Marcus Yarns (29 TD in 2 yrs), and the QB battle (Minicucci's mobility/upside vs Marker's accurate-but-needs-clean-pocket) is philosophical. Both hurt by injury last year. Mike: no official play, lean over — more a 5-7 team than a 2-10 year-zero; Duck sees 5 wins.

teams.key_avoids: Beats Bethune-Cookman, takes a paycheck loss at Penn State, likely losses at UConn + Liberty; then nearly everything is winnable. Prefers to have caught Kennesaw/Jacksonville State/Sam Houston earlier — instead gets them late.
teams.bboc_notes: A feisty out — new HC Willie Simmons is a slam-dunk hire (won at Prairie View + FAMU, elite Florida recruiter, sneaker-head player's coach, one of few African-American FBS HCs) who commands the room the prior regime couldn't. Up-tempo, spread, shotgun ('Shotgun Simmons'). QB Keyone Jenkins is good-and-bad in the same game (19 BTT / 15 TWP) but cooked late (12 TD, 1 INT in the final 4 with no sacks). Retained DC (4th yr — continuity), secondary could be special (Brian Blades, an NFL type), plus two FSU edge transfers. Both PASS the win total (5.5 is priced right, 14-1 doesn't move them) but back them SITUATIONALLY — swag/community energy (Miami Vice unis, Hispanic Heritage night). Bowl-capable, higher floor than expected.

teams.key_avoids: CANNOT win CUSA (FBS newcomer). USC + SMU in the first three weeks, then at Western Kentucky (Sept 27) — a badly skewed early stat profile. Late slate softens (Middle Tennessee, New Mexico State, FIU, Liberty, UTEP, Kennesaw, La Tech). Hosts La Tech in the finale (a great fade-La-Tech spot).
teams.bboc_notes: [Eligibility note: newcomer, ineligible for the CUSA title game.] Don't sell early — maybe the best QB in the conference in Jacob Clark (6-5, 225; 70% comp, 3,600 yds, 26 TD, 3rd in FCS passing efficiency), plus real weapons (Isaiah McMorris, James Blackstrain, TE Dylan Hip from Ole Miss). 17th in returning production (8th offense). The bugaboo is the OL — young, allowed 40 sacks / 84 TFL last year; if it gels the offense hums. Defense will get exposed (11 of top-13 tacklers gone; struggled vs the run vs top FCS). An OVER team weekly — get the early Missouri State overs before the market catches up. Mike: don't sell early on Ryan Beard.

teams.key_avoids: First three at UCF, Liberty, at Georgia Southern (could get humbled), then Murray State gimme; at Southern Miss (a WKU-caliber revenge spot for USM); the schedule softens mid-year (at Sam Houston, Delaware home, at MTSU, at UTEP, Kennesaw, at FIU).
teams.bboc_notes: A FADE and a first-to-worst candidate (both under 6.5, Mike's favorite CUSA under, Duck 4-8). DEAD LAST in FBS returning production (last in defensive production). Not just a new HC — Charles Kelly (never a head coach at any level) — but a full scheme change from Rich Rod's spread-option to Clint Trickett's spread. Trickett's QBs have been poor (Cam Fancher 1:1; JC French 20 TWP as his passing-game coordinator at Ga Southern), and Gavin Wimsatt is a red-zone-demon runner but 17 TD / 21 INT. The defense will get shredded (no continuity; DC Brian Williams' Maryland units cratered). An anonymous CUSA assistant called them a first-to-worst candidate — both hosts agree.

teams.key_avoids: Quality opponents sprinkled to kill momentum — at LSU, Southern Miss at home in September, then Washington State + Liberty back-to-back late. Finale AT Missouri State (a brutal spot if not bowl-motivated).
teams.bboc_notes: Mike's FAVORITE CUSA under (both under 6.5). The offense has gotten worse every year under Sonny Cumby, bottoming out in 2024 (<3 TD/game, 111th in total offense). QB Evan Bullock is the 'Neil O'Donnell effect' — he protected the ball as a freshman only by eating sacks (2nd-highest sack rate in FBS behind Jackson Arnold). OL returns two starters but leans on two sophomores and lost a Wake-bound LT in the spring; WRs super green. The one thing that kept them competitive — DC Jeremiah Johnson's elite D (12th total, 14th red-zone) — left for Coastal; new DC Luke Olsen (from JSU) inherits a front six with ONE returning starter and no pass rush. Mid-season-collapse / coach-on-the-hot-seat risk (Cumby).

teams.key_avoids: Opens Western Kentucky in wk0 (could get run off the field) + a non-con trip to Oregon State. Plays 'home' games an hour away in a soccer stadium (little home-field edge). Fade spots throughout.
teams.bboc_notes: A fade lean — Mike leans under, Duck flags fade spots. Big philosophical 180: HC Casey Keeler (who built the rock-solid D) left for Temple, and new OC Phil Longo brings his tempo air-raid… onto a roster with only one main WR returning and game-manager QB Hunter Watson (a poor fit if asked to throw 30+). 117th in returning production; the DEFENSE that carried them is GUTTED — ZERO returning starters, the DC + a starter gone to North Texas, barely a competent two-deep in the spring. Expect three-and-outs that leave a rebuilt D exposed; an over team by circumstance. Both saw wk0 vs WKU going badly (Colin/Mike bet that over).

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Liberty AND UTEP in conference play — a huge break. Non-con at Wisconsin, at Nevada, FCS Austin Peay; toughest conf game is at Western Kentucky (100 miles of hate). Hosts Missouri State after a bye; closes at New Mexico State.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Duck is the believer (OVER 4.5 at -148, a future at 25-1 he priced at 16-1, and his CUSA title-game pick), Mike is skeptical (leans under, doesn't see the dynamic playmakers). Year 2 of Derek Mason (respected on D) but his 2024 unit was bottom-20 in nearly everything. 69th in returning production, 13 returning starters; QB Nicholas Vattiato back but they cut his designed runs (139→86 carries, 29 of them sacks) and it hurt the offense. Duck likes the OL/DL/LB continuity + RB Jaiden Mendelbrook / Ricky Hunt (Ohio) for a 6-6 leap. The soft draw (no Liberty/UTEP) is the whole bull case.

teams.key_avoids: At Wake, at Indiana (depth/tired-legs fade), Arkansas State early; Liberty in the finale (Liberty's red-ink revenge for 2024). Duck flags ~3 fade spots.
teams.bboc_notes: Wait-and-see with a fade lean — new HC Jerry Mack (HBCU success at NC Central, NFL + Rice OC experience, but his Rice offense stunk). Full scheme change from the leftover option/inverted-pistol to up-tempo; QB Dexter Williams II (Georgia Southern). 5th in returning production (3rd on D) but that D was 100th+ last year, and the OL could be really bad in pass-pro (curtailing Williams). Same defense that lost 33-0 to La Tech to end the year. Mike waits on the pace metrics (2024 stats meaningless); Duck fades the depth (at Indiana) + the Liberty finale. Mike's rant: 29-1 to win CUSA is an insulting price for a no-shot team ('give us 100-1').

teams.key_avoids: Five winnable home games (Bryant, Tulsa, Missouri State, Kennesaw, Middle Tennessee). Road slate brutal — at Liberty, at Western Kentucky, at Tennessee, at UTEP. Upset watch: New Mexico (Land of Enchantment rivalry).
teams.bboc_notes: A fade lean — the Diego Pavia days feel far away. New OC David Yost (career journeyman play-caller, a real upgrade) and QB Logan Fife (Fresno) — but Mike calls Fife the most C+/B- G5 QB available (holds the ball too long, arguably the worst FBS QB play in 2024 among his room). 21st in returning production but the OL returns just one starter and the D had only 14 sacks / 44 TFL. HC Tony Sanchez (elite Bishop Gorman HS pedigree) has topped four wins only once in six FBS years. Duck bet the under (plus money); Mike leans under / mostly a stay-away. Two-hundred-plus-to-1 to win CUSA — a pass.
